name: My Demonic Jungle Quest
source:
Yesterday, you were just another warrior in your tribe. Today, you are on the run with the unlikeliest of allies as you race to defeat a great and terrible evil.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3990370/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
昨天，你还只是部落里一名平平无奇的战士；今天，你却与最意想不到的盟友并肩亡命奔逃，争分夺秒去击败一股可怕的滔天邪恶。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3990370/]Steam[/url]]
